new_findings.finding: _pin_for (score/score_runner.py:152-156) returns the binding report's observed_sha256 VERBATIM, but the fxng3 binding report (schema d2c_family_binding_report@2) stores NESTED dicts for the two consumed inputs: CANCPIALLMINMEI observed_sha256 = {'raw pull realtime_start=2015-01-01&realtime_end=2026-09-01': 'b6ad1e6d...', 'raw pull realtime_start=2018-01-01&realtime_end=2026-09-01': '152b795e...', 'derived restricted-event stream (this lane)': 'e7f3b9ad...'} and USDCAD observed_sha256 = {'assembled repull artifact': '8401427d...'}. score_fxng3 (:312-315) therefore passes a dict as expected_sha256 to load_events/load_bars; _verify_digest compares the hex digest against str(dict).lower() and raises ValueError('DIGEST_MISMATCH ...') UNCONDITIONALLY. At E-phase FXNG3 would deterministically burn its observed slot with NOT_ADJUDICABLE(technical) — a preventable guaranteed loss of one of the three one-shot diagnostic cells.
new_findings.evidence: Empirically demonstrated by this audit on the real binding report + real bound file (read-only): '_pin_for' returns dict for both inputs; 'load_events(dict pin) raises: DIGEST_MISMATCH for ...CANCPIALLMINMEI_derived_events.json: expected {raw pull ...'. CNG2 pins plumb correctly (flat hex str) — the defect is FXNG3-only.
new_findings.remediation: Resolve the flat sub-digest of the CONSUMED artifact: events -> observed_sha256['derived restricted-event stream (this lane)'] == e7f3b9ad12037c497ef48e6ae9da478224df6401131e31e47b65c5d57c3f9e12 (re-hashed exact by this audit against the committed file) and bars -> observed_sha256['assembled repull artifact'] == 8401427da0c2cb46391d9481d2190df7ae9aee319fd37e7c298cf573ed2755ff (re-hashed exact); alternatively add flat observed_sha256 entries for the two consumed artifacts to the binding report. Fail closed if the resolved pin is not a 64-hex string.
